title: Authentication Bypass - Unauthenticated Access to addPrescription Mutation
description: The GraphQL API endpoint allows completely unauthenticated access to the addPrescription mutation. No authentication is required to create new prescriptions, allowing arbitrary users (including unauthenticated attackers) to inject prescriptions into the system for any userId without identity verification. The mutation resolver does not validate authentication credentials or session tokens before processing prescription creation requests. An attacker can manipulate the userId parameter to create prescriptions for any user in the system without any access control checks.
impact: Complete authentication bypass on write operations. Attackers can create malicious prescriptions, inject data into other users' records, pollute the database, and manipulate patient medication records without any credentials or authorization. This allows data tampering, unauthorized record creation, and potential patient safety risks if prescriptions are falsified or modified.
remediation:
1. Implement authentication middleware that validates JWT tokens or session credentials before processing any GraphQL mutations
2. Add authentication checks to the addPrescription mutation resolver to verify user identity
3. Implement authorization checks to ensure users can only create prescriptions for themselves or with proper administrative privileges
4. Validate that the userId parameter matches the authenticated user's identity or is authorized by admin role
5. Add @auth directive or similar authorization mechanism to all sensitive mutations in the GraphQL schema
6. Implement comprehensive audit logging for all mutation operations including user identity, timestamp, and affected data
7. Add rate limiting to prevent abuse of prescription creation functionality
8. Consider implementing field-level permissions in the GraphQL schema
references: OWASP A01:2021 - Broken Access Control, OWASP API2:2019 - Broken User Authentication, CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function, CWE-862: Missing Authorization
toolCallDescription: Document the critical authentication bypass vulnerability on GraphQL addPrescription mutation with confirmed working POC
